Taiwan (province of China) has a separate row; both rows open the same China panel. The CSV includes all reporting areas matching the current filters, including rows on other pages.

Data and definitions

Intake estimates were calculated from the GDD 2018 estimates provided by the Global Dietary Database, Tufts University. Incidence: IARC GLOBOCAN 2024. Population scenario: World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant, with age-specific incidence rates held constant within each reporting area. The scenario reports annual cases in 2050. Basemap: Natural Earth.
